resources.title: ffmpeg-wasm
resources.description: ffmpeg-wasm is a WebAssembly port of FFmpeg, providing scripts and commands to build FFmpeg for WebAssembly. It powers applications like wide.video, a free online video editor, and ffmpeg.wide.video, an online FFmpeg tool.

resources.title: FFmpeg Mailing Lists & IRC (Official)
resources.description: Official FFmpeg community channels: ffmpeg-devel (patch review), ffmpeg-user (help), libav-user mailing lists, plus IRC channel info.
